research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01. Unresolved: named legal employers, employer/control transitions within 1996–2011, non-executive entities, university contract and status, Reserve full-time deployments and civilian leave. No headline total calculable.

Potential finance lead: IOOF 2009 report identifies an Andrew McLachlan as CEO Private Client and AWM Service Co employee; 30 April 2009 is merger/KMP entry, not necessarily employment commencement. Search of IOOF, AWM, Executor Trustees and senator/Army combinations did not independently resolve identity. Follow via AWM 2008 report https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20081023/pdf/31d2whx0mq6vyy.pdf and earlier employer biographies.

Cosoff Cudmore Knox surfaced in a people-directory search snippet, but no primary employer or accessible professional profile confirmation; not promoted to supported fact. WRP Legal & Advisory appears in interest summaries and may be an association rather than employment. Follow original register before adding a spell.

Namesake exclusion: Coolabah/Vianova credit analyst explicitly described as full-time is a different career and is not evidence for this senator. Sydney pharmacy professor and overseas law/hotel executives also excluded.

Attempted APH, first-party biography, party biography, St Peter’s governance, St John annual report, IOOF report, professional profile, contemporary ICFS coverage, military article and maiden-speech discovery. APH and Informit returned 403; LinkedIn 999; OpenAustralia 26 February 2020 speech URL inaccessible. These are source gaps, not job-wide errors.

Qualifications LLB, LLM and MBA confirmed by official/school biographies. Study is not employment; do not fill 1991–1993 gap with an invented continuous study interval. Membership/fellowship is not employment.

Follow-up order: employer identity and historical annual reports; military deployment dates/full-time duty and civilian leave; university appointment contract; reconcile St John chair start May/June 2013. Missing evidence remains unknown, not zero.

Follow-up2026-10-02: contemporary military report narrows Afghanistan deployment to2011; exact active-duty period, hours/status and civilian leave unresolved. Canadian Major Andrew McLachlan CD is a different officer and excluded.

AWM2008report now inspected: executive contract, salary and matching AL initials strengthen but do not settle identity. Remuneration and no-expiry agreement are not full-time evidence. Future lead: AET historical biography or signed appointment linked to Army/ICFS. Do not repeatedly search the same AWM/IOOF combinations without a new identity source.

Johnston Withers1989–1991, Cosoff Cudmore Knox1993–1996, Sir Ross and Sir Keith Smith Fund2002–2011 and Liberal vice-president2010–2013 remain unverified directory leads. Artificial January endpoints from directory not used. Law Society2011author/subject index located but full article not obtained. Searches of primary employer, university, army and professional-profile combinations did not resolve identity or hours. No contacts collected or outreach.

Namesake check: Friends of Port Willunga treasurer/retired Pedal PrixCEO has different accounting career; not assigned to senator. Full financial-services/employer sequence, university contract, deployment leave and StJohnchair date discrepancy remain follow-up needs.
